stories.title: Wildfires kill two in Greece, Belgium's largest blaze spreads toward Germany
new_facts: Separate, unrelated house fire in Atlanta killed two people; no connection to UK/Europe heatwave story.
Two dead in Salamina/Salamis wildfires; 200 firefighters battling two blazes on the Greek island.
Belgium wildfire has doubled in size in 24 hours, now burning over 7,000 acres, spreading toward Germany.
Belgium fighting biggest forest fire in over a century near German border; 600 evacuated; confirms two Salamis deaths.
Heatwave hit nearly 37C in Belgium Friday; hundreds evacuated from nature reserve fire.
stories.line: Fast-moving wildfires kill two on a Greek island and spread across Belgium toward Germany, forcing evacuations and overwhelming local firefighting capacity.

stories.title: Stripe buys AI model marketplace OpenRouter for $7B

stories.title: Tommy John, pitcher whose elbow surgery transformed baseball, dies at 83
new_facts: Establishes death at 83; 1974 UCL tear at age 31 that ended pitchers' careers before his surgery.
Adds specific Dodgers tenure years: 1972-74 and 1976-78.
Adds four All-Star selections, White Sox/Yankees teams, and 26-season career length.
Adds wife Cheryl, death at Florida home, recent hospice care, Yankees tribute, per TMZ.
Reveals John had recently written a farewell message to Yankees fans before death.
stories.line: Tommy John, the pitcher whose 1974 elbow surgery became a standard procedure in baseball, has died at 83.

stories.title: Four Renaissance paintings stolen from Sicilian museum
new_facts: Adds detail that theft occurred during a religious festival drawing 100,000 people to Messina.
Art expert Alberto Fiz estimates the stolen Antonello works' value at 70-80 million euros.
Names the specific stolen artwork: three panels from Antonello da Messina's Polittico di San Gregorio.
stories.line: Four Renaissance paintings were stolen from a museum in Messina, Sicily during a holiday when security was lighter.
